status_of_ranks: TRIAGE, not truth. No evidence was added, no dimension added, no weighted score built.
rank_conventions: rank = RRA consensus rank among ALL eligible genes (method=min), as consensus_rank in the committed Top-50 CSVs; delta = scheme rank - ORIGINAL rank (positive = fell); in_top50 = in the scheme's top-600 -> one-gene-per-LD-block -> head(50) list; None = no evidence under that scheme (no rank).

direct.basis: MAGMA on Davies 2018 (CHARGE+COGENT+UKB); also the ELIGIBILITY FLOOR of every scheme (MAGMA FDR<0.05)

replication.basis: strict catalog units (count includes Davies' own PMID unit and UKB-listed units) + Savage 2018 Z/100 (shares UKB)

finemap.basis: Open Targets GWAS credible sets + L2G of the strict-tier studies (UKB-heavy); per-gene reachability from UKB-free studies evaluated

coloc.basis: brain QTL (GTEx, ROSMAP, BrainSeq, CommonMind, ...) x direct-cognition GWAS; queried only for the 400 Davies-top genes

direction.basis: sign agreement over the same colocalisation records

positive_human.basis: 2q12.3 duplication CNV-GWAS (PMID 39667348); UKB share undetermined; present for 2 eligible genes (SOWAHC, SEPTIN10)

adult_modifiability.basis: GTEx v10 + BrainSpan; not association evidence

module.basis: modules built on Davies FDR<0.01 genes; module rank uses Davies evidence share

extreme.basis: sensitivity-only; Zabaneh controls (HRS) are a CHARGE cohort

caveats: Every scheme keeps the ORIGINAL eligibility floor (Davies MAGMA FDR<0.05), so even INDEPENDENT_ONLY and LEAVE_LINEAGE_OUT rank only genes the UKB-containing GWAS already selected.
UKB-free is not Davies-free: Davies 2018 includes CHARGE and COGENT cohorts, and cohort membership of the 'verified UKB-free' catalog cohorts in CHARGE/COGENT is not recorded in the repository.
Studies with no cohort record (e.g. Lee 2018 cognitive performance, Lam 2017, Sniekers 2017, Coleman 2019) are UKB_UNKNOWN -> UNDETERMINED, never independent (dependency rule D005).

The pipeline's n_strict_ukb_free_units counts Perry 2025 (PMID 39891803) as UKB-free because its cohort list element is 'UKB ' with a trailing space; the cohort string names UKB. Lahti 2022 ('multiple') is unverifiable. Both are re-classified here.

Strong-coloc QTL datasets are counted as independent units per the brief, but the GWAS half of every colocalisation is the same UKB-heavy lineage; ROSMAP/CommonMind/BrainSeq/GTEx donor overlap is not resolved in the repository. The QTL half is not a separate consensus dimension, so no scheme can rank on it without adding a dimension (forbidden).

ClinGen HI=3/TS=3 is counted as a perturbation unit per the brief; the repository holds only the MONDO ID, so relevance to cognition (vs e.g. cardiac or cancer phenotypes) is not verified here, and HI=3 is loss-of-function harm, never evidence that raising the gene raises cognition.

The module dimension gives all 310 M01 genes rank 1, so LEAVE_LINEAGE_OUT (natural) is essentially module membership with massive ties; its top 50 is decided by tie-breaking, not evidence. The same M01 floor creates rank plateaus in other schemes (e.g. many genes tie at one rank under LINEAGE_COLLAPSED_MEAN, natural): a gene AT the cutoff rank may be in or out of a top 50 by sort order alone -- see top50_cutoff_ties and top50_membership_tie_decided_* (true also for ORIGINAL).
A gene outside a scheme's top 50 is not 'refuted': in_top50 is a triage flag.
Collapsed lineage lists are re-ranked before RRA; using the raw minimum would reward genes measured on more lineage dimensions, which is the multiple counting being removed.
